name: Perdue Farms
note: Rating note: the ownership claim cites Perdue's own release ("fourth-generation, family-owned, U.S. food and agriculture company", 2026-07-20). A US Department of Labor investigation found Perdue jointly employed children in hazardous occupations at its Accomac, Va. plant (2025-01-15; $4M restitution, $150,000 civil penalty). Held at unrated for a maintainer to weigh that company finding against METHOD.md.
